<!-- Thanks for contributing! / 感谢贡献！ -->

**What does this change, and why? / 改了什么，为什么？**


**Checklist / 检查**

- [ ] `uv run pytest`, `uvx ruff check` and `npm test` (in `app/`) pass / 测试和代码检查通过
- [ ] New interface text is added to every file in `app/src/locales/` / 新增的界面文字已补到每个语言文件
- [ ] No personal photos, local paths, `index/` or `config.json` in the change or its screenshots / 改动和截图里没有个人照片、本机路径、`index/` 或 `config.json`
